A fresh perspective on animal health

Every pet has their own pace.

At PEAKPET, we believe every pet has unique potential. The goal isn't to turn them into athletes, but to help them live better through a plan built around their health, physical condition and real needs.

1

Finally, support.We track progress, review goals and adjust the program when needed.

Frequently asked questions

Every pet
has their own path.

PEAKPET aims to support well-being with personalized care, without universal promises of results.

Does my pet need to be an athlete to participate?

No. Our approach is also designed for sedentary pets, overweight animals, seniors and caregivers seeking healthier habits. Every plan depends on a clinical assessment.

Do you work with cats?

Yes. Activities for cats should respect their preferences, motivations and behavior. Movement may include play, environmental enrichment and adapted stimulation.

Can you recommend a homemade diet or commercial pet food?

Recommendations follow a review of each patient's history and nutritional needs. Any formulated diet must be complete and balanced for that patient, under veterinary supervision.

How is progress measured?

Through professional checkups and relevant records: weight, body condition, muscle condition, adherence, functional status and exercise tolerance, as appropriate.

Does this replace regular veterinary care?

No. PEAKPET services complement routine veterinary care and may require referrals to other specialties when health concerns arise.
